saints.name: The Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary
saints.title: Solemnity of the Blessed Virgin Mary
saints.shortBlurb: The Church honors Mary preserved from the first instant of her conception free from every stain of original sin…
biography: This solemnity celebrates the truth, defined as a dogma of the faith by Pope Pius IX in 1854, that the Blessed Virgin Mary was preserved from all stain of original sin from the very first moment of her conception, by a singular grace and in view of the merits of her Son. It is the Advent feast of the all-holy Mother made ready to bear the Lord.

Kept on 8 December, nine months before the feast of Mary's Nativity on 8 September, it is in many places a holy day of obligation, and under this title the Blessed Virgin is honored as the patroness of the United States.
saints.knownFor: Mary conceived without sin, the fitting dwelling prepared for the Son of God.
